method: Each new case ran twice under node scripts/harness.mjs bounded: first with the named source file at its HEAD bytes (the control arm) and then with the working-tree bytes (the changed arm); a pass is a non-zero control exit and a zero changed exit. The runner swapped one file at a time and restored it before the changed arm. Node cases ran as node --test --test-name-pattern=<case> <source>; the shell case ran as bash scripts/test-release.sh --case meter_shape. The record was taken after the self-review fixes, on the bytes the complete run judges.

pairedControls.control: At the base no rule judges WO-006, WO-006-D018, FUP-280abd447f789958, VER-001, FINAL-001, REVIEW-007 or WS-001 in a target's artifacts.
pairedControls.changed: identifier.launchpad refuses each form in each kind for a target and passes for a launchpad artifact, the records commit message and Closes #4.

pairedControls.control: At the base a listed word refuses under vocabulary.launchpad with no section.
pairedControls.changed: A listed word is a vocabulary.review finding with its word, line and part, and the status is review.

pairedControls.control: At the base an empty terms array and the reviewTerms key are invalid.
pairedControls.changed: reviewTerms may be empty, terms is read as an alias with an advisory, both keys refuse.

pairedControls.control: At the base every private term refuses and a marker is part of the term.
pairedControls.changed: refuse: refuses by line and mode, an unmarked term is a review item, a malformed marker refuses naming the line.

pairedControls.control: At the base a present list with no terms throws present but empty or malformed.
pairedControls.changed: A present list with no terms is present with a count of zero and refuses nothing.

pairedControls.control: At the base the CLI has no --target flag and a review match exits 1.
pairedControls.changed: A review match exits 4, --target refuses an identifier with exit 1, and the lint never prints the term.

pairedControls.control: At the base there is no composed body with sections and rows.
pairedControls.changed: composeTargetBody names the parts and the Change rows by path with existing and kit paths marked.

pairedControls.control: At the base no check judges the stored body's heading, prose or meter position.
pairedControls.changed: pullRequestBodyShapeFailures reports heading-first, prose-before-meter and meter-last, admitting the product-gate block in a published body.

pairedControls.control: At the base absoluteBodyLinks cannot map a resolved path onto the target's tree.
pairedControls.changed: A moved record's link is written absolute to the target and other relative links become text.

pairedControls.control: At the base a review-mode private term refuses the loadout-route publish as vocabulary.local.
pairedControls.changed: The publish names the review items and the digest, refuses a stale or malformed confirmation, publishes under the digest and records the confirmation.

pairedControls.control: At the base the draft refuses every listed word by line with no path or part, and the target's own mask.ts row is reported.
pairedControls.changed: An identifier in an added path refuses by path and part, review words wait for the confirmation, existing and kit paths are not reported, and the prepared commit holds across refusals.

pairedControls.control: At the base worktree publish refuses --confirm-terms as a usage error.
pairedControls.changed: worktree publish reads --confirm-terms out before each target route's argument check.

pairedControls.control: At the base the close record binds no body and a changed header is not read.
pairedControls.changed: The legacy body is byte for byte, the record binds its source and digest, and a Release published with the legacy body stays current under the reviewed header.

pairedControls.control: At the base the Release body is the title and objective whatever the header says and no notes file is read.
pairedControls.changed: Absent or invalid notes refuse before any tag push, the rendered notes publish under a confirmed review, the digest binds a retry and changed notes refuse.

pairedControls.control: At the base plan check returns no advisories.
pairedControls.changed: plan check names the target order's paths that carry a review word or an identifier and none for the launchpad order.

pairedControls.control: At the base the redacted findings carry no mode and a present list reports no count.
pairedControls.changed: Findings carry mode review and a present list reports its term count.

pairedControls.control: At the base release prepare replaces the meter block in place and check-surfaces judges no body shape.
pairedControls.changed: release prepare and the regenerated body move the block after the prose and check-surfaces refuses a stored body that breaks the shape.
